name: Croissants
desc: A full 24 hour lamination: detrempe, butter block, three folds

ingredients.raw: 4 2/3 cups (605 g) all-purpose or bread flour, plus more for dusting
1 tbsp plus 1/2 tsp (12 g) kosher salt
3/4 cup plus 2 tbsp (214 g) water, at room temperature
1/2 cup (120 g) whole milk, at room temperature
1/4 cup (57 g) unsalted butter, softened, for the dough
1 1/4 cups (280 g) cold unsalted butter, for the butter block

steps: Twenty-four hours before serving, start the detrempe. In a stand mixer with the dough hook, combine the flour, sugar, salt and yeast. Make a well and pour in the water and milk. Mix on low until a tight, smooth dough forms around the hook, about 5 minutes. Cover with a damp towel and rest 10 minutes.
On medium-low, add the softened butter a bit at a time until fully worked in. Shape into a rectangle, wrap, and refrigerate overnight.
Make the butter block: pound the cold butter between parchment into an even 8 inch square. Keep cold.
Roll the detrempe to twice the size of the butter block, seal the butter inside, and roll out to a long rectangle.
Give it a letter fold, wrap, and chill 45 minutes. Repeat twice more, chilling between each fold.
Roll the laminated dough to about 1/4 inch thick and cut into long triangles.
Roll each triangle from the base to the tip, curve the ends, and place on lined sheets.
Proof at room temperature 2 to 3 hours until visibly puffy and jiggly.
Brush with egg wash and bake at 400F for 18 to 22 minutes until deep golden and hollow-sounding.
